mapper.select: WITH UltimoEstatusID AS ( SELECT idEnvio, idHistorialEstatusEnvio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY idEnvio ORDER BY tiempo DESC ) as FilaNumero FROM historialestatusenvio ) SELECT e.idEnvio, e.noGuia, e.nombreDest, e.apellidoPatDest, e.apellidoMatDest, e.numDest, e.calleDest, c.idColonia AS idColoniaDest, c.codigoPostal AS codigoPostalDest, c.colonia AS coloniaDest, ci.ciudad AS ciudadDest, es.estado AS estadoDest, cli.idCliente, cli.nombre AS nombreCliente, cli.apellidoPaterno AS apellidoPatCliente, cli.apellidoMaterno AS apellidoMatCliente, cli.correo AS correoCliente, cli.telefono AS telefonoCliente, cli.numero AS numeroCliente, cli.calle AS calleCliente, cli.idColonia AS idColoniaCliente, ccli.codigoPostal AS codigoPostalCliente, ccli.colonia AS coloniaCliente, s.idSucursal, s.nombre AS nombreSucursal, s.CUS AS CUSSucursal, s.numero AS numeroSucursal, s.calle AS calleSucursal, s.idColonia AS idColoniaSucursal, cs.codigoPostal AS codigoPostalSucursal, cs.colonia AS coloniaSucursal, cis.ciudad AS ciudadSucursal, ess.estado AS estadoSucursal, con.idConductor, con.noLicencia AS noLicenciaConductor, colcon.nombre AS nombreConductor, colcon.apellidoPaterno AS apellidoPatConductor, colcon.apellidoMaterno AS apellidoMatConductor, hee.idHistorialEstatusEnvio, ee.idEstatusEnvio, ee.estatus, hee.motivo, hee.tiempo, col.idColaborador, col.nombre AS nombreColaborador, col.apellidoPaterno AS apellidoPatColaborador, col.apellidoMaterno AS apellidoMatColaborador FROM envio e INNER JOIN UltimoEstatusID u ON e.idEnvio = u.idEnvio AND u.FilaNumero = 1 INNER JOIN historialestatusenvio hee ON u.idHistorialEstatusEnvio = hee.idHistorialEstatusEnvio INNER JOIN estatusenvio ee ON hee.idEstatusEnvio = ee.idEstatusEnvio INNER JOIN colaborador col ON hee.idColaborador = col.idColaborador INNER JOIN colonia c ON e.idColonia = c.idColonia INNER JOIN ciudad ci ON c.idCiudad = ci.idCiudad INNER JOIN estado es ON ci.idEstado = es.idEstado INNER JOIN cliente cli ON e.idCliente = cli.idCliente INNER JOIN colonia ccli ON cli.idColonia = ccli.idColonia INNER JOIN sucursal s ON s.idSucursal = e.idSucursal INNER JOIN colonia cs ON s.idColonia = cs.idColonia INNER JOIN ciudad cis ON cs.idCiudad = cis.idCiudad INNER JOIN estado ess ON cis.idEstado = ess.idEstado LEFT JOIN conductor con ON e.idConductor = con.idConductor LEFT JOIN colaborador colcon ON con.noPersonal = colcon.noPersonal ORDER BY e.idEnvio ASC;
